The leadership dispute at Fountain of Life Church has taken another turn, with the church postponing its thanksgiving service scheduled for 22 November.
The development comes amid disagreements over who should lead the church following the death of its founder, Taiwo Odukoya.
PREMIUM TIMES earlier reported that the church’s Board of Trustees (BoT) announced the immediate removal of Jimmy Odukoya as senior pastor, triggering a dispute over the succession arrangement.
The board explained that it based its decision on a previously undisclosed video recording in which the late founder outlined his succession instructions.
It subsequently named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as the interim spiritual and administrative head of the church. The board also made public another video in which Mr Odukoya named Pastor Adekunle Areogun as his successor.
Jimmy and the church, however, rejected the board’s position, maintaining that he remained the senior pastor.
However, in a statement posted on its social media platforms on Thursday, the church announced that it had postponed the thanksgiving service.

This newspaper obtained the statement, which did not give a reason for the decision or announce an alternative date.
The statement read: “Please be informed that our Thanksgiving 2026 Service, previously scheduled for Sunday, November 22, has been postponed. A new date will be communicated in due course.”
Meanwhile, the board instituted legal proceedings against Jimmy at the Lagos State High Court, the Cable newspaper reported.
The matter, filed as LD/0126PRA/2026, came before Justice O. O. Adewunmi-Oshin on Wednesday, who restrained Jimmy from parading himself as the senior pastor of the church.
The claimant asked the court to stop Jimmy from presenting himself as the church’s senior pastor and spiritual leader pending the determination of the suit.
The church’s trustees maintained that Jimmy no longer occupied the position, arguing that late Odukoya had appointed a successor before his death.
The document read: “1. A pre-emptive order of injunction restraining the respondent, whether acting personally or through any proxies from holding himself out as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church (the “Church”) having ceased to hold the office based on the appointment of a successor by the late Founder and Senior Pastor of the Church, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the Church pending the Applicant’s full compliance with the High Court of Lagos State (Expeditious Disposal of Civil Cases) Practice Directions No. 2 of 2019 on Pre-action Protocol.
“2. A pre-emptive order of injunction restraining the respondent, whether acting personally or through any proxies in any alleged capacity as the Senior Pastor of the Church, from interfering, disrupting, meddling with and/or obstructing the activities, governance and any other business of the Church pending the Applicant’s full compliance with the High Court of Lagos State (Expeditious Disposal of Civil Cases) Practice Directions No. 2 of 2019 on Pre-action Protocol.
“3. And for such further order(s) the Honourable Court may deem fit to make in the circumstances. It is hereby ordered as follows: Leave is hereby granted to the Applicant to commence this action under the Pre-Action Protocol pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the High Court of Lagos State (Expeditious Disposal of Civil Cases) Practice Direction No. 2 of 2019.”
